appearance.identity: Silver glass tower with re-entrant corners, gentle taper and mapped splayed entrance canopies.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

brief: Budgeted ICC preserves tower, corners and all mapped glass-splay strips; distance tiers merge facade grids and roof mullions.

sourceFacts.form: Re-entrant corners, three sheltered canopies and north-side atrium
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original121424-triangle14407700-byte source reproduced exactly; detailed original recipe preserved. Independent browser derivatives retain the distinguishing exterior with tiered detail.

geographic.notes: Existing484m authored tower retains its exact-QID re-entrant footprint and signed mapped north atrium/canopy strips. One inspected exterior picture supports silver horizontal bands, re-entrant corners and splayed glass entrance roof. Standard viewer PMTiles checks tower/road placement; off-footprint[-80,0] supplies approximate terrain contact and a bounded local rectangular correction covers the tower/canopies. Raw elevations remain separately retained. Heights, subtle taper, pane schedule and podium connections stay reconstructed; surrounding Elements complex excluded. No surveyed fit claimed.
